faq.question: Can I switch plans at any time?
faq.answer: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated based on your billing cycle. Downgrades are applied at the start of your next cycle.

faq.question: Do you offer a free trial?
faq.answer: Every paid plan includes a 14-day free trial with full access to features. No credit card is required to start.

faq.question: What happens if I exceed my usage limits?
faq.answer: We will notify you as you approach your limit. Overage charges are calculated at a flat per-request rate, or you can upgrade to a higher plan.

faq.question: Is there a discount for nonprofits and open source?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer significant discounts for qualifying nonprofits, educational institutions, and open-source projects. Contact sales for details.

faq.question: Can I run PolyAccess on my own infrastructure?
faq.answer: Enterprise customers can choose a managed private cloud or on-premise deployment. Our team will help you meet your security and compliance requirements.
